_comment: Brief 42 §A/§B — the security headers, as TRACKED CONFIG rather than a string in a script.
Same reasoning as config/deploy-targets.json: a policy that lives in code is a policy nobody
reviews. This file is the input to scripts/facade-audit.mjs, which checks it against what the
built PWA actually requires and refuses a policy that would break the facade.
THE FACADE IS THE ACCEPTANCE CRITERION (§E4). A CSP that breaks Stillpoint's rendering in
Hidden mode is a covert-mode failure discovered by a survivor, so this policy is derived from
an audit of the real bundle and not from a template.

_derivation: 0 inline <script>, 0 inline <style>  -> no 'unsafe-inline', no nonces, no hashes needed
blob: used by capture (MediaRecorder + createObjectURL) -> media-src/img-src need blob:
only network destination is the API origin -> connect-src is exactly that plus 'self'
no wasm, no `new Worker`, no external fonts, no third-party anything

_comment: Classified 2026-08-03 by reading each occurrence in the built bundle. A URL in an error
message, a documentation shortlink, or a string written INTO a report is not a fetch, so
none of these belong in connect-src — adding them would widen the policy for no reason.
They are listed so the audit can tell a CLASSIFIED mention from a NEW one. An origin
appearing here that is not on this list is a signal: either a new dependency started
talking to something, or a fetch was added. Both are worth a look before enforcing.
_originsMentionedButNeverFetched.https://bit.ly: Workbox console.warn — a docs shortlink in a precache warning string
_originsMentionedButNeverFetched.https://www.blackboxsentinel.com: the verification URL written into a certified report for a recipient to visit; the app never requests it

_hsts: §B/§E3 — max-age 15552000 is 180 days. NOT two years, and preload is NOT requested,
because HSTS is hard to reverse and this domain is under active development. A preload
entry is removed on Chrome's timetable, not ours, and pages.dev is a shared apex we do not
control. 180 days is long enough to be a real commitment and short enough to unwind.
_referrer: §B/§D — no-referrer, not strict-origin-when-cross-origin. The coordinator dashboard is
reached by an event-bound magic token in the URL, and any policy that emits a Referer at
all leaks that token's page to whatever the recipient clicks next.
_permissions: §B — only what capture needs. Everything else is denied explicitly rather than left to a
headers.Permissions-Policy: microphone=(self), camera=(self), geolocation=(self), accelerometer=(), ambient-light-sensor=(), autoplay=(), battery=(), display-capture=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=(), midi=(), payment=(), usb=(), xr-spatial-tracking=()
